raw_line: Neuvillette Best Hypercarry Team (Neuvillette — Vodyanitsa — Furina — Escoffier)
description: Vodyanitsa supports Neuvillette and Furina's new Freeze Team with Escoffier. Neuvillette can easily stack Fanfare for Furina due to his HP drain.

raw_line: Neuvillette Lunar-Charged Team (Neuvillette — Ineffa — Columbina — Sucrose)
description: Columbina and Ineffa makes up the core of the team, while Sucrose amplifies them with EM. In scenarios like this, Neuvillette acts more as on-field driver that deals damage with his Charged Attack.
